extraMeanings.en: very, extremely (informal intensifier)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: That was mighty kind of you to help us.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bize yardım etmen çok nazikti.

extraMeanings.en: to move around in a confused mass (mill around)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Crowds of people were milling around the entrance.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Girişin çevresinde kalabalıklar amaçsızca dolanıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to copy the way someone speaks or behaves
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She can mimic the teacher's accent perfectly.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenin aksanını mükemmel şekilde taklit edebiliyor.

extraMeanings.en: the one that belongs to me
extraMeanings.exampleEn: That book is mine, not yours.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O kitap benimki, senin değil.

extraMeanings.en: a bomb hidden under the ground or in the water
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The soldiers were careful not to step on a mine.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Askerler bir mayına basmamak için dikkatliydi.

extraMeanings.en: a candy flavored with mint
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She offered me a mint after dinner.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yemekten sonra bana bir nane şekeri ikram etti.

extraMeanings.en: a place where coins are made; to produce money
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The coins were struck at the royal mint.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Madeni paralar kraliyet darphanesinde basıldı.

extraMeanings.en: to laugh at someone in an unkind way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The other kids mocked him for his old clothes.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Diğer çocuklar eski kıyafetleri yüzünden onunla alay etti.

extraMeanings.en: a short cannon that fires shells high into the air
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The base came under heavy mortar fire.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Üs yoğun havan topu ateşine maruz kaldı.

extraMeanings.en: a formal proposal put to a vote at a meeting
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The motion was passed by a large majority.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Önerge büyük bir çoğunlukla kabul edildi.

extraMeanings.tr: işaret etmek, el kol hareketiyle göstermek
extraMeanings.en: to signal to someone with a gesture
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She motioned for me to sit down.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Oturmam için bana işaret etti.

extraMeanings.en: to shape a soft material; to influence someone's character
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The teacher helped mold the young students into responsible adults.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen genç öğrencileri sorumluluk sahibi yetişkinler olacak şekilde biçimlendirmeye yardım etti.

extraMeanings.tr: kıssadan hisse, ders (bir hikâyenin verdiği ders)
extraMeanings.en: a lesson taught by a story or event
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The moral of the story is that honesty pays off.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hikâyenin kıssadan hissesi, dürüstlüğün karşılığını verdiğidir.

extraMeanings.en: a person or thing that inspires an artist
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The painter said his wife was his greatest muse.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ressam, karısının en büyük ilham kaynağı olduğunu söyledi.

extraMeanings.en: a number that contains another an exact number of times
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Twelve is a multiple of three.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: On iki, üçün bir katıdır.

extraMeanings.tr: (zor bir durumla) başa çıkmak, üstesinden gelmek
extraMeanings.en: to deal successfully with a complicated situation
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It can be hard to navigate the complex tax system.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Karmaşık vergi sistemiyle başa çıkmak zor olabilir.

extraMeanings.en: very good, pleasing (informal)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: That's a really neat idea!
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu gerçekten harika bir fikir!

extraMeanings.en: (of an alcoholic drink) served without ice or water
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He ordered a whiskey, neat.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sek bir viski söyledi.

extraMeanings.en: to fail to care for or give attention to something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He neglected his health while working long hours.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Uzun saatler çalışırken sağlığını ihmal etti.

extraMeanings.en: to fail to do something (neglect to do)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She neglected to mention that she would be late.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Geç kalacağını söylemeyi ihmal etti.

extraMeanings.en: courage or confidence
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He didn't have the nerve to ask her out.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ona çıkma teklif edecek cesareti yoktu.

extraMeanings.en: rude behavior showing a lack of respect
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She had the nerve to blame me for her own mistake.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kendi hatası için beni suçlayacak yüzsüzlüğü gösterdi.

extraMeanings.en: a material made of crossed threads with holes between
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The fisherman pulled the net full of fish onto the boat.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Balıkçı balık dolu ağı tekneye çekti.

extraMeanings.en: to gain something as a profit
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company netted a huge profit last year.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirket geçen yıl büyük bir kâr elde etti.

extraMeanings.en: to officially appoint someone to a position or job
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She was nominated as the new chairperson of the committee.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Komitenin yeni başkanı olarak atandı.
